Class C2paWasm

java.lang.Object
de.christianmahnke.iiif.fliiifenleger.wasm.WasmModule
de.christianmahnke.jc2pa.C2paWasm
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable
public class C2paWasm extends WasmModule
Low-level binding to the c2pa_wasm WASM module.

Each public method corresponds directly to one #[no_mangle] pub extern "C" export from lib.rs.

The module is executed by a pluggable WasmEngine: by default the pure-JVM Chicory interpreter (works on every JVM), with an automatic switch to GraalVM's WebAssembly runtime when running on a GraalVM that has the polyglot artifacts on the classpath. See WasmEngine.create(String, byte[]).

Type mapping between Rust and Java: 

  Rust          Java
  ──────────── ────────────────────────────────────────────
  *const u8    int   (WASM linear memory address)
  *mut u8      int   (WASM linear memory address)
  *mut *mut u8 int   (address of a 4-byte pointer slot)
  *mut u32     int   (address of a 4-byte u32 slot)
  u32          int   (sign-extended; use & 0xFFFFFFFFL if unsigned needed)
  i32          int

Use WasmMemory to read and write the raw bytes behind any pointer that is returned or passed in.

This class is Closeable; always call WasmModule.close() (or use try-with-resources) to release the Chicory instance.

    • trustAnchorsSet

      public void trustAnchorsSet(String pem) throws C2paException
      trust_anchors_set(pem_ptr, pem_len, err_ptr, err_len) -> u32

      Install a PEM trust anchor bundle for subsequently created readers (process-global, like all c2pa-rs settings). Readers then report "Trusted" instead of merely "Valid" when the signing chain anchors in the bundle. Set once before validating; use trustAnchorsClear() afterwards for isolation.

      Parameters:
      pem - PEM bundle (one or more certificates), validated eagerly.
      Throws:
      C2paException - if the bundle is malformed.

    • trustAnchorsClear

      trust_anchors_clear(err_ptr, err_len) -> u32

      Drop previously installed trust anchors; readers go back to unanchored validation.
